map.节源于航海测速绳结，1 节=1 海里/小时，与经纬度距离天然匹配，便于按分纬度估: The knot comes from the knots on a nautical log line; 1 knot = 1 nautical mile per hour, which matches latitude/longitude distance naturally and makes estimating distance from minutes of latitude easy.

map.：1 节=1 海里/小时=1.852 km/h=0.5144 m/s；20 节≈: : 1 knot = 1 nautical mile/hour = 1.852 km/h = 0.5144 m/s; 20 knots ≈ 10.289 m/s ≈ 37.040 km/h ≈ 23.016 mph. Note 1 nautical mile ≈ 1852m, and knots to km/h is a fixed conversion, so keep a sensible number of decimals.
